02 — BEYOND TRADITION

Rice, nuruk, water.
Nothing else.

Brewed from rice grown in the sea winds of Haenam, at the southern tip of Korea. No sweeteners, no additives — the traditional three-stage brew, refined by our own way of fermenting and aging.

Non-Artificial, Very Traditional Our story
03 — SIGNATURE

Chowol 6.9

6.9% · 600ml / 750ml

Forty-eight days of patience

A traditional three-stage brew, fermented and aged for 48 days. A full body meets delicate sweetness and a bright, gentle acidity — at home on any table.

Body Sweet Acidity

04 — DEEP SERIES

Depth,
transcended

Fully fermented for over 56 days. A gently spicy character reminiscent of whisky and Korean distilled soju, with a dry finish.

05 — NEW

SPKL

Sparkling · 15.6% · 750ml

Makgeolli, for the wine glass

Haenam glutinous rice and nuruk, brightened with tart cherry. Fine natural bubbles and a vivid acidity — a new Chowol that drinks like a fruit wine.

06 — BEYOND LIMITS

A glass of makgeolli,
at the fine table

Beyond the Korean restaurant — to fine dining, bars, lounges, galleries and concept stores. Chowol shapes each glass to the character of its space.

Dining · Bars · Lounges · Galleries · Concept stores

07 — BREWERY

A brewery in
the heart of the city

Beneath Gongdeok Station, among reclaimed timber pillars and folding-screen walls, we brew Chowol. Drop by — no reservation needed — to taste from our own glassware and take a bottle home.
